1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Harga
dan Antipencatutan (Penentuan Harga Maksimum) (No. 10) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa bagi tempoh mulai 8 Jun 2023 hingga 7 Julai 2023.

Harga runcit maksimum

2. Harga runcit maksimum bagi minyak masak kelapa sawit tulen dalam botol
mengikut kuantiti  yang dinyatakan  dalam ruang (1)  Jadual ditentukan sebagaimana  yang
dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING ACT 2011

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING
(DETERMINATION OF MAXIMUM PRICE) (NO. 10) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of the
Price Control and Anti -Profiteering Act 2011 [ Act 723 ], the Controller,
with the approval of the Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

Maximum retail price
2. The maximum retail price for bottled pure palm cooking oil based on
the quantity specified in column (1) of the Schedule is determined as specified
 in column (2).
1.     (1) This order may be cited as the Price Control and Anti-Profiteering
(Determination of Maximum Price) (No. 10) Order 2023.

(2)       This Order has effect for the period from 8 June 2023 to 7 July 2023.
